overview: DiffuDETR formulates object detection as a conditional object query generation task by integrating DETR-based models with denoising diffusion training to progressively denoise reference points from a Gaussian prior, achieving consistent improvements across COCO, LVIS, and V3DET benchmarks.

modules.name: Configuration Management
modules.description: Centralized experiment configuration system supporting YAML/JSON parsing, hierarchical config inheritance for different model variants (DiffuDETR, DiffuDINO, DiffuAlignDETR), dataset-specific settings (COCO, LVIS, V3DET), and ablation study parameter sweeps including noise distributions, schedulers, decoder evaluation steps, and query counts.

modules.name: Data Processing Pipeline
modules.description: Dataset-specific preprocessing and loading for COCO 2017, LVIS, and V3DET, including default COCO augmentations from Detrex, repeated sampler for V3DET with repeat factor, multi-scale feature map preparation with four-scale configuration, and batch processing strategies accommodating different memory constraints per backbone.

modules.name: Backbone & Multi-scale Feature Extraction
modules.description: Multi-scale feature extraction from ResNet-50, ResNet-101, and Swin-B backbones, producing four-scale feature maps with consistent spatial resolution configuration, supporting frozen and fine-tuned backbone modes, and interfacing with the transformer encoder for deformable attention sampling.

modules.name: Transformer Encoder with Deformable Attention
modules.description: Multi-scale deformable attention-based transformer encoder that processes backbone features into encoded visual representations, capturing rich contextual information at various spatial resolutions to serve as the foundational representation for the detection pipeline.

modules.name: Diffusion Process Module
modules.description: Core diffusion process implementation including forward noise addition to normalized reference points via configurable noise distributions (Gaussian, Beta, Sigmoid Gaussian), noise schedulers (Cosine, Linear, Square Root) controlling variance schedules, and DDIM-based reverse sampling for inference with support for varying timesteps (100 training steps, 3 inference steps).

modules.name: Diffusion-aware Transformer Decoder
modules.description: Modified transformer decoder layer integrating timestep embedding, self-attention, multi-scale deformable attention conditioned on noisy reference points, and feed-forward networks, iteratively refining noisy queries against encoded image features with timestep-conditioned modulation following the equation qn = FFN(MSDA(SA(qn-1) + t), rt, Oenc).

modules.name: Contrastive Denoising Queries Module
modules.description: Implementation of DINO's contrastive denoising (CDN) auxiliary task for DiffuDINO, including hard negative injection for contrastive loss, mixed query selection from high-confidence encoder outputs, and learnable class embeddings for content query initialization, with configurable number of CDN denoising queries.

modules.name: Model Integration & Assembly
modules.description: Full model assembly for DiffuDETR (built on Deformable DETR decoder without two-stage variant, with encoder loss), DiffuDINO (built on DINO decoder with CDNs), and DiffuAlignDETR (built on Align-DETR), handling the connection between encoder outputs, diffusion-sampled reference points, learnable content queries, and prediction heads.

modules.name: Loss Functions & Hungarian Matching
modules.description: Bipartite set matching via Hungarian algorithm for one-to-one prediction-ground truth alignment, combined detection losses including classification loss, L1 bounding box regression loss, GIoU loss, and auxiliary contrastive denoising loss for DiffuDINO, with support for encoder-only loss in DiffuDETR.

modules.name: Training Engine
modules.description: Training loop orchestration with epoch-based learning rate decay schedules (COCO 50-epoch with decay at 40, 12-epoch with decay at 11), AdamW optimization, exponential moving average (EMA) model updates for training stability, gradient handling, and per-dataset iteration scheduling with learning rate milestone decay.

modules.name: Inference Pipeline with Multi-step DDIM Decoding
modules.description: Inference-time reference point generation from Gaussian noise followed by iterative DDIM denoising through configurable decoder evaluations, sampling K reference points per query from N(0,I), applying deterministic DDIM update rule across timesteps, and supporting flexible decoder evaluation counts for accuracy-efficiency tradeoff.

modules.name: Evaluation & Metrics Computation
modules.description: Comprehensive metric calculation including COCO-style mAP (AP, AP50, AP75, APs, APm, APl), LVIS extended metrics (APr, APc, APf) for long-tail category distributions, V3DET evaluation protocols, and multi-seed statistical analysis with mean and standard deviation reporting across sparse/dense scene subsets.

modules.name: Ablation & Sensitivity Analysis Framework
modules.description: Systematic ablation study infrastructure covering noise distribution comparison (Gaussian, Beta, Sigmoid Gaussian), scheduler comparison (Cosine, Linear, Square Root), decoder evaluation sweep (1, 3, 5, 10 steps), query count variation (300, 900, 1500), and multi-seed robustness analysis with dense/sparse scene partitioning.

modules.name: Computational Cost Profiling
modules.description: Measurement and comparison of computational requirements including FLOPs (in GigaFLOPs), activation memory (in millions), and inference latency across DETR variants, supporting per-model profiling with mean and standard deviation reporting for fair computational efficiency comparison.

modules.name: Visualization & Result Reporting
modules.description: Qualitative visualization of detection results with confidence thresholding, comparison across models and decoder evaluation steps, automated generation of performance tables for COCO/LVIS/V3DET, convergence plots, noise scheduler signal retention curves, and per-seed result aggregation for publication-ready output.
